assertions.name: harness_reproduces_the_recorded_form_A_negative
assertions.source: leading orders Delta(net)_A = -2*eps^1 and Delta tr_M = -5/4*eps^1, matching qbeta-delta-tr-vs-formA.witness.json's recorded '-2 eps' and '-5/4 eps'. The harness is trusted against the existing record BEFORE anything new is read from it.

assertions.name: delta_tr_is_NOT_the_ruled_z_D_slot_object
assertions.source: Delta tr_M - tr_M(Delta, z_D) does not vanish identically. Leading orders: Delta tr_M = -5/4*eps^1, tr_M at z_D = -1*eps^1. So the 2026-08-08 negative EXTENDS to the ruled base -- re-aiming it at the canonical convention does not rescue the identification.

assertions.name: delta_tr_is_NOT_the_augmentation_slot_object_either
assertions.source: Delta tr_M - tr_M(Delta, z=q) does not vanish identically either (leading -2*eps^1). Both admissible functionals are tested, so this is not a statement about the ruled cell alone.

assertions.name: the_z_D_mismatch_is_structural_not_a_normalisation
assertions.source: the term-by-term ratio is NOT constant across k (5 distinct values over 5 orders; sign set ['-1', '1']). A constant ratio would mean the two series differ only by normalisation, which would make the mismatch uninteresting. It is not constant, so the objects are structurally distinct -- the same discipline the sibling probe applied to the Form A negative.

description: Re-aims the corpus's 2026-08-08 negative against the Habiro route at the RULED base. qbeta-delta-tr-vs-formA compares Delta tr_M against Form A's net-winding slot -- the z = 1 cell, which the owner retired as the base on 2026-09-08, one day after that witness was last touched. This re-runs the same comparison against the Markov trace at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) (the ruled epsilon) and against the augmentation z = q (the other admissible point), calibrating first against the recorded Form A figures. Scope (a), proton pin, convention D. Asserts nothing about alpha.
scope: (a) scope-limited: these exact objects at the proton pin under convention D. It does NOT derive alpha, does not exclude the Habiro ring from an alpha closure by another route, and does not retract the 2026-08-08 Form A negative -- that inequality is an exact algebraic fact and stands on its own terms. What it settles is only whether re-aiming that negative at the ruled base changes its verdict.
